description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation. The chart contains six slices representing different data sources. The “ENTITYQUEST” slice is blue and accounts for 26.0% of the total. “TRIVIAQA” is represented by a peach-colored slice and comprises 22.7%. The “HOTPOTQA” slice is red and represents 24.2% of the data. “POP-QA” is orange and makes up 21.6% of the total. “TREC” is green and represents 1.9%, while a final, small slice labeled with a gray color represents 3.6%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each data source. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
